The '''Ardan Cross''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] largely in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. It bordered a large portion of [[The Roil/Legends|The Roil]] until the [[Feena Run]] pulled into the nebula.
